beats.headline: 26/11 WAS NOT CHAOS
beats.text: November 2008. Ten men sailed into Mumbai. They weren't born killers. They were built — by a curriculum.

beats.headline: FROM THE COURT RECORD
beats.text: Using court testimony from Ajmal Kasab and David Headley, we reconstruct how Lashkar-e-Taiba builds a fighter.

beats.headline: THE CAMPS
beats.text: A network of camps — Muridke, Muzaffarabad, Mansehra — each with a job.

beats.headline: 21 DAYS OF BELIEF
beats.text: Daura-e-Sufa: twenty-one days of indoctrination. No guns yet.

beats.headline: 21 DAYS OF BODY
beats.text: Daura-e-Aam: the basic course, and the first filter.

beats.headline: THE LOYALTY TEST
beats.text: Khidmat: two months of chores that weed out the uncommitted.

beats.headline: THREE MONTHS OF WEAPONS
beats.text: Daura-e-Khaas: the stage that turns a believer into an operative.

beats.headline: PROVEN VS ALLEGED
beats.text: Did the state know? We separate what courts established from what is only alleged.

beats.headline: MAY 2025: OP SINDOOR
beats.text: Then, in May 2025, Operation Sindoor struck nine sites — including the compound where it all began.

beats.headline: INSIDE THE TERROR FACTORY
beats.text: Inside the Terror Factory. The full documentary is out now on The Sisodia Files.
